function.name: terminal_exec
function.description: Spawn a terminal command. Returns output if the command finishes before timeout; otherwise returns the terminal name and timeout status.

terminal_name.description: Optional human-readable terminal name. If omitted, a name such as powershell-1 or sh-1 is assigned.

timeout.description: How many seconds to wait before returning.

function.name: list_terminals
function.description: List known terminal sessions by name, id, and status.

function.name: terminal_checkout
function.description: Check current terminal output and status by terminal name without waiting.

terminal_name.description: Terminal name returned by terminal_exec or list_terminals.

lines.description: Number of latest output lines to return.

function.name: terminal_kill
function.description: Kill a running terminal command by terminal name and return final output.

terminal_name.description: Terminal name returned by terminal_exec or list_terminals.

lines.description: Number of latest output lines to return after killing.
